rows.definition: compaction_ab.go (internal/ablate, #2805) is the LIVE compaction ON-vs-OFF A/B arm: a controlled split over MATCHED real guard sessions that reports the net dollar delta (shed saving MINUS the cache-creation burst compaction causes when it rewrites history), never gross shed.
rows.distinction: The A/B VALUATION that prices compaction's causal dollar delta on real traffic - not compaction (the provider prefix-reuse mechanism it isolates) and not CompactionView (the lossy savings model that strips recovery handles).

rows.definition: compaction_on_vs_off is the internal/ablate CompactionABArmID string constant naming the sweep-row arm for the ON-vs-OFF net-of-burst dollar delta the compaction_ab file reports.
rows.distinction: The ARM-ID label stamped on a sweep row - not compaction_ab (the file/valuation that produces the row) and not compaction (the wire mechanism whose value the arm prices).

rows.definition: CompactionReport is the internal/gatewayusageledger struct folding compaction-ledger rows into a (budget x length-band) segmentation over a --since window, carrying exit/quarantined row counts and per-segment shed totals for `fak cachevalue compaction`.
rows.distinction: The LEDGER fold over compaction segments (what `fak cachevalue compaction` renders) - not CompactionFired (the gateway counter of compaction attempts) and not compaction (the wire mechanism whose ledger it folds).

rows.definition: FoldCompaction is the internal/gatewayusageledger function that folds ledger rows into the (budget x length-band) CompactionReport segmentation over the whole --since window (FoldCompactionByPeriod with no time bucketing).
rows.distinction: The FOLD function that produces a CompactionReport - not CompactionReport (the struct it returns) and not compaction (the wire mechanism whose ledger rows it folds).

rows.definition: CtxExpense is the internal/gateway struct surfacing the per-session expense verdict beside the OBSERVED tokens in a CtxValueReport: a closed 3-level decision (ok/warn/block) graded on the ESTIMATED per-turn as-sent volume, never the observed resident count.
rows.distinction: The DECISION verdict over an ESTIMATED per-turn volume - not CtxValueReport (the report it rides on, whose Tokens are OBSERVED) and not ctxFootprintBytes (the raw byte accumulator the verdict is graded on).

rows.definition: ctxExpenseWarn is the internal/gateway Server field holding the effective per-turn-as-sent-volume token threshold above which assessCtxExpense returns the warn tier (0 = the built-in 120k default; negative = that tier disabled).
rows.distinction: The WARN-tier threshold knob - not ctxExpenseBlock (the block-tier threshold sibling) and not CtxExpense (the verdict struct the threshold feeds into).

rows.definition: ctxExpenseBlock is the internal/gateway Server field holding the effective per-turn-as-sent-volume token threshold above which assessCtxExpense returns the block tier (0 = the built-in 180k default; negative = that tier disabled).
rows.distinction: The BLOCK-tier threshold knob - not ctxExpenseWarn (the warn-tier threshold sibling) and not ctxExpenseNoteOnce (the gate that actuates on a block verdict).

rows.definition: ctxExpenseNoteOnce is the internal/gateway Server method behind FAK_CTX_EXPENSE_GATE: the opt-in, once-per-session in-band [fak] advisory a block-tier expense verdict emits, telling the agent to checkpoint and end the turn - never refusing the request.
rows.distinction: The GATE that actuates on a block verdict - not CtxExpense (the verdict it reads) and not observeCtxValue (the general per-turn fold that carries the verdict on the report).

rows.definition: ctxFootprintBytes is the internal/gateway per-trace accumulator's raw byte record of the latest inbound footprint: the exact, additive byte split (system + built-in tools + MCP tools + history + tail) that CtxValueFootprint renders into ESTIMATED tokens.
rows.distinction: The raw BYTE accumulator (exact, additive) - not CtxExpense (the verdict graded on its total) and not CtxValueReport (the report whose footprint it feeds).

rows.definition: ctxrestore_store.go (internal/gateway, #3062) is the GENERALIZED restore-by-digest router: the adapter that lets a fak_context_restore call resolve bytes from any content-addressed ctxplan.Store, not just the compaction-tombstone stash in ctxrestore.go.
rows.distinction: The SOURCE-AGNOSTIC router over any ctxplan.Store - not restoreContext (the stash-specific method it falls through to) and not Server.ctxRestore (the compaction-tombstone stash it generalizes).

rows.definition: OpContextRestore is the internal/sessionread ReadOp enum value ('context-restore') naming the one full-disclosure read op: pages one dropped span back in by its content-address handle, honoring the ctxplan seal/tombstone trust gate.
rows.distinction: The READ-OP vocabulary entry for restore - not restoreContext (the gateway method that implements it) and not fak_context_restore (the MCP tool surface the op is dispatched from).

rows.definition: adviseCtxStep is the internal/gateway pure step-advice policy: a closed StepClass verdict (any/bounded/checkpoint/rebuild/unknown) graded on the rolling session's turns, context events, resident growth, and budget - advice-only, never enforced.
rows.distinction: The pure step-ADVICE policy over the rolling session - not CtxValueReport (the report that carries its verdict) and not ctxplan (the planner that selects resident spans, a different optimization).

rows.definition: CtxValueSnapshot is the internal/gateway multi-session HTTP body: every tracked session's CtxValueReport rendered at once (optionally filtered to one trace), returned by the fleet-wide ctxvalue endpoint.
rows.distinction: The MULTI-session snapshot body - not CtxValueReport (the single-session report it is a list of) and not context-snapshot (the vcache witness-snapshot path flag, a different snapshot entirely).

rows.definition: DefaultContextCap is the internal/microagent constant (8192) that NewContext(0) selects as the token ceiling for a mini-SWE-agent's bounded linear history - a usable starting default, not a model-specific window.
rows.distinction: The microagent LINEAR-HISTORY cap default - not context-window (the model's hard limit) and not HardContextCap (the ctxplan envelope's provider-advertised ceiling).

rows.definition: NewContext is the internal/microagent constructor building an empty bounded linear-history Context whose FIFO history is capped at tokenCap tokens (DefaultContextCap when 0), enforced with the same tokenizer the guard boot path uses.
rows.distinction: The microagent CONTEXT constructor (bounded linear history) - not NewCtxStore (the recall store adapter, a different 'new ctx' entirely) and not contextq (the playbook subsystem whose NewContextPlaybook is a different constructor).

rows.definition: NewCtxStore is the internal/recall constructor wrapping a reloaded *Session as a ctxplan.Store - the first REAL store implementation the ctxplan planner views, so a sealed page reads as a Sealed Span and a tombstoned page as a Tombstoned one.
rows.distinction: The CONSTRUCTOR that adapts a recall Session into a ctxplan.Store - not CtxStore (the type it returns) and not NewContext (the microagent context constructor, a different 'new ctx' entirely).

rows.definition: principalFromContext is the internal/gateway function returning the request-scoped isolation principal (or empty) from a Go context.Context - the per-principal boundary that scopes restore/spans reads to the caller's own trace.
rows.distinction: The ISOLATION-principal extractor from a Go context.Context - not ContextChangeRequest (the recall mutation it gates) and not context-mmu (the result-admission gate, a different 'context' boundary).

rows.definition: RequiredContext is the internal/modelroute CapacitySignal field carrying the minimum context-window tokens a target model must offer to accept a reroute - the routing-side dual of context-window, checked against a target's usable context.
rows.distinction: The ROUTING capacity floor (a model must have this much context) - not context-window (the model's hard limit) and not ContextTokensLeft (the live remaining budget, a different 'how much context' counter).
